meta.test_only: The key below is a throwaway made for these tests. It protects nothing and no real server or login service may trust it.
meta.key_derivation: private seed = SHA-256 of the ASCII text "re-psn sign-in pass test vectors: TEST ONLY, not a secret"; Ed25519 as in RFC 8032
meta.fields: pass and now (unix seconds) are the input. accept is what the Go server does today; strict, when present, is what a strict verifier must do instead (see docs/api.md). reason is the Go server's log text for a refusal and is informative only. sub, scope and exp are the claims of an accepted pass. audience replaces the meta audience for one vector.
